description: Odoo plugin hooks: core-file and grant-file protection, inline-JS check in Odoo modules, ask-before-destroying guard for Odoo volumes and databases, restart/clone advisories, and Odoo version detection

hooks.command: s="${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_ROOT}/hooks/frontend/session_start.py"; [ -f "$s" ] || exit 0; for c in python3 python py; do command -v $c >/dev/null 2>&1 || continue; [ $c = py ] && c='py -3'; $c "$s"; r=$?; [ $r -eq 49 ] || exit $r; done; exit 0
